#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Install the iPhone profile and build fixes onto the pinned UniXNU checkout."""
import argparse,subprocess,shutil
from pathlib import Path
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('upstream',type=Path);a=p.parse_args();u=a.upstream.resolve();here=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(u),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
if head!='04573c510c5fd4892ca6948739389141cc9e05f5':raise SystemExit('Unexpected upstream revision')
patch=here/'upstream-build.patch'
if subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(u),'apply','--reverse','--check',str(patch)],capture_output=True).returncode:
 subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(u),'apply','--check',str(patch)],check=True)
 subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(u),'apply',str(patch)],check=True)
shutil.copytree(here/'upstream-overlay',u,dirs_exist_ok=True)
prelink=u/'kits/XnuPrelink'
revision=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(prelink),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
if revision!='b74ed7c74a07f0eb5f81089c660905ecc4cabb7f':raise SystemExit('Unexpected XnuPrelink revision')
for patch in sorted((here/'patches/xnuprelink').glob('*.patch')):
 if subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(prelink),'apply','--reverse','--check',str(patch)],capture_output=True).returncode:
  subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(prelink),'apply','--check',str(patch)],check=True)
  subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(prelink),'apply',str(patch)],check=True)
shutil.copytree(here/'fixtures',prelink/'fixtures',dirs_exist_ok=True)
print('Installed iPhone 24A446 profile, layout/BTI patches and reviewed identities; not boot qualified')

device/myron27/README.md.content:
# myron upstream iPhone iOS 27 integration

Target: Redmi K90 Pro Max / SM8850, iPhone iOS 27.0.1 (24A446), donor iPhone12,1/N104, arm64e.
Upstream: UniXNU/UniXNU at `04573c510c5fd4892ca6948739389141cc9e05f5`.
XNU: apple-oss-distributions/xnu at `ac9718fb1af618d5ce8678d0dc6e8a58f252216f`
(`12377.121.6`, with upstream Darwin 26 compatibility patches).

This is configuration/source migration, not a bootable release. `board.example`
blocks phone packaging; `kernel --skip-prelink` permits host-only compilation.
The older `kernel/myron` configuration and R90 release remain separate.

## Completed host work

- Upstream `unixnu status --json` selects arm64e, the 24A446 profile and the
  upstream architecture/OS patch chains. No XNU 10063 patch is selected.
- Board DTS compiles with the preserved myron RAM/GIC/CPU description.
- SM8850 Affinity2 and CCIDX patches are rebased against XNU 12377 source.
  All 72 selected patches now apply to the complete pinned XNU source.
  The iPhone boot-progress patch omits the optional sheng PMGR hook.
- The actual patched cache decoder passes existing UBSan host tests, including
  the recorded R52 register sample, legacy format, wide associativity and
  invalid/overflow rejection.

## Integration still required

1. Qualify PAC at EL1 and EL0 on every CPU that will be enabled. R90 arm64
   execution does not prove arm64e/PAC access through the firmware/hypervisor.
2. Reconcile the local ArmCpu override against the pinned upstream revision;
   compile all platform/PMGR/IRQ components with the new XNU headers.
3. Port the existing myron UFS transport and readonly root binding to the
   target storage ABI. Do not substitute SM8550 controller/PHY defaults.
4. Use the 24A446 kernelcache, DeviceTree, trust modules, OS and SystemOS images.
   Rebuild root policies and an appropriate Data seed. R90's 21H461 binaries,
   private offsets, trust bundle and image hashes are not inputs for this OS.
5. Integrate the arm64e display/HID/KeyStore components and the original
   fileset ABI. Do not copy the 21H461 display vtable offsets or GPU addresses.
6. Reconcile the myron UEFI loader, memory reservations and payload packaging
   with current DarwinBoot. Re-run the host handoff tests against new objects.
7. Complete full patch application, kernel build, LTO reference, prelink,
   package and boot-image checks before offering a phone test.

The 32 GiB `unixnu` partition remains an existing device resource. No partition
or image write is part of this source migration. Any new installation must
check actual image sizes and bind the existing partition GUID; upstream sheng
userdata examples must not be applied to Android userdata.

## Reproduce current checks

From the pinned UniXNU checkout (`DEVICE` is this directory):

```sh
./unixnu status --json -D "$DEVICE"
python3 "$DEVICE/verify_migration.py" --upstream "$PWD" --xnu /path/to/xnu-12377
dtc -I dts -O dtb -i "$DEVICE/../sm8850/dts" \
  -o /tmp/myron27-hardware.dtb "$DEVICE/dts/myron.dts"
```

The resolved component catalog is a source/version plan, not evidence that all
components have been fetched, built or run. Keep `example = true` until phone integration is implemented. Native host
compilation is supported independently of phone-image qualification.

References: https://github.com/UniXNU/UniXNU/pull/155 and upstream
`docs/zh/porting/arm64e.md`, `docs/zh/porting/migration.md`.

## iPhone target and current build result

The Apple BuildManifest and decompressed DeviceTree identify iPhone12,1,
N104/N104AP, ApChipID 0x8030 and ApBoardID 4. All four extracted components
are SHA256-pinned in the new OS profile. The decompressed kernelcache is an
arm64e MH_FILESET with 243 entries. iPad root UUIDs, kext roots, AMFI addresses
and regression-policy pins have been removed rather than reused.

Linux target propagation and compiler-rt now follow the selected architecture
and deployment target. Actual Mach-O probe objects verify arm64/iOS17 remains
arm64 and arm64e/iOS27 produces subtype 2 with iOS 27 deployment. Four existing
kernel staging tests pass. Full native compilation was attempted and reached
libfirehose after header generation, where the retained Clang 24 rejects the
fourth __ptrauth parameter, "authenticates-null-values". This ABI behavior is
not removed. check_compiler.py reproduces the missing feature before building.

The Apple-toolchain CI input is .ci/myron27-macos.yml with a complete hashed
source snapshot. The job first builds the native kernel, then independently checks UFS source,
an LTO reference and strict iPhone prelink. A successful job is not evidence
that UFS root, display, or SpringBoard is running.

The second macOS attempt passed the compiler feature check and compiled the
kernel and selected components, then failed final linking with missing
`source_corecrypto14_original` and `source_corecrypto14_start_once`.
The inherited `prelinked` mode undefines `XNU_SOURCE_CORECRYPTO14` only for
`prng_random.o`, removing both definitions while OSKext still references them.
The iPhone target now selects upstream `source` bootstrap mode and rejects
the incompatible setting before compilation. This restores the real early
provider initialization and its start-once helpers, including the original
fileset-provider preference and full POST; it does not substitute stubs or
skip crypto checks. Full native linking passed in run 41566051862; runtime POST still requires verification.

ArmCpu is rebased to upstream 93a5030c with the new processor-registration
ordering and bootInitialized guard. Darwin assembly newline delimiters and
the SGI probe's corrected operands are retained in the iPhone device override;
the older myron/SM8850 driver remains unchanged.

## Verified macOS native build (2026-11-03)

Run [41566051862](https://github.com/yuwenhua653/UniXNU/actions/runs/41566051862),
remote commit `b20ce1f5610cc4225a699dfd3ed4669383ae92a0`, passed the final link.
Downloaded artifact 13199357291 has SHA256
`6bd0430368170445d03ab7c7231b82c4b527fbf3371b2389b611c70725b9716a`.
The actual 25,715,656-byte native kernel matches the CI SHA256 and has arm64e
subtype `0xc0000002`, iPhoneOS platform 2, minimum OS 27.0, no undefined
symbol-table entries, and all four real crypto bootstrap definitions.
The bootstrap-pass missing `_corecrypto_kext_start` message is followed by
archive generation and a successful final link; it is not a final build failure.

Run `python3 verify_native_artifact.py /path/to/extracted-artifact` to repeat
these checks. This checks native Mach-O evidence only. The empty prelink
segments, disabled UFS/display configuration and unchanged `board.example`
mean this artifact is not a phone firmware. The following real-input checks identified changes needed before prelink.

## Desktop integration: real-input blockers (2026-11-03)

The pinned 24A446 donor decompresses to 67,534,848 bytes, SHA256
`813be26ab6bd1d8de211904eca413a1a2ebf79989f90c33a48ff0f2fcff99036`.
The selected 30 iPhone roots resolve to 38 retained entries. The missing
iPad-only IOHIDEventDriver root is not requested; IOHIDFamily is retained.

Actual strict prelink of the verified native artifact first rejected a
constant-segment overlap. Native DATA_CONST plus LASTDATA_CONST needs 0x120000
bytes, but the first retained constant starts at offset 0x11a4c8. The layout
patch borrows 0x6000 bytes of unused preceding PRELINK_TEXT tail using the
native 4 KiB granule, preserving retained driver addresses and the 16 KiB
chained-fixup page format. It refuses occupied or noncontiguous spans. All
63 XnuPrelink unit tests pass, including four new layout regression tests.

The real-input retry passed layout and stopped because the old standalone
kernel lacks split-segment relocation records. The target now enables
CONFIG_XNU_KERNEL_CHAINED_FIXUPS; the artifact verifier requires both
split-segment v2 and chained-fixup commands before prelink. This configuration
change requires a new native build. The old artifact fails the new gate as
expected; enabling the option alone is not evidence the new build passes.

The same CI job will compile the existing myron UFS transport against pinned
public storage headers, build the upstream RELEASE LTO comparison kernel,
fetch/hash the iPhone donor components, and attempt strict prelink without
missing-call stubs. Every independent stage records its result even if another
fails. The comparison kernel is never a boot candidate. UFS compilation does
not bind or qualify the original storage family's private ABI. No old absolute
addresses or iPad ABI anchors are added. Logs, source/object digests, and
prelink metadata are retained; original Apple IPSW components are not uploaded
as CI artifacts. Phone packaging and partition writes remain disabled.

## Run 8: native build passed, strict prelink still blocked (2026-11-03)

[Run 41569729023](https://github.com/yuwenhua653/UniXNU/actions/runs/41569729023)
passed native compilation/linking, relocation checks, UFS source compilation and
RELEASE LTO reference generation. Its failure is the final strict prelink:
303 unresolved retained-driver references, not a compiler failure.

A local replay of the exact downloaded native and LTO binaries now leaves **5**
unresolved references. The repair normalizes optional function-entry BTI during
comparison only, and adds 112 reviewed function identities plus 15 data identities
for the SHA256-pinned iPhone donor. The fixture records evidence and full original
function hashes; validation checks the actual donor, native symbol existence and
function boundaries before prelink. These are build-time identities, not proof of
runtime ABI correctness. No authentication instructions are removed from output.

All 66 XnuPrelink tests pass. Fresh installation and repeated installation pass;
wrong-donor and altered-function-hash checks reject their inputs. The replay still
fails closed: no candidate image, no missing-call stubs, no runtime qualification.
The detailed evidence is `records/prelink-repair-41569729023.json`.

The remaining references are one new DriverKit `IOService::CallPlatformFunction`
RPC and four Image4 V2 / TXM entry points (selectors 52 through 55). They are absent
from the pinned native kernel. The four private API names in the record are
candidates inferred from the donor symbolset and calling patterns; they must not
be treated as implemented interfaces or replaced with success-returning stubs.
The next change must port their contracts and caller integration before rerunning
full CI. The public uppercase DriverKit RPC is not the lowercase platform callback.

Repeat prelink without rebuilding XNU, after applying this directory's installer
to the pinned upstream checkout:

```sh
python3 "$DEVICE/replay_prelink.py" \
  --artifact-root /path/to/extracted-run8-artifact \
  --kernelcache /path/to/iphone-24A446-kernelcache.decompressed \
  --xnuprelink "$UPSTREAM/kits/XnuPrelink" \
  --out /path/to/new-empty-replay-directory
```

Exit status 1 with five unresolved references is the historical run-8 replay result.
No new full CI run or phone test is justified by this partial repair alone.

## DriverKit source implementation and Image4 contract audit (2026-11-03)

The next target-only patch now implements the missing nonvirtual
`IOService::CallPlatformFunction` client RPC. It serializes the donor's exact
request, invokes the existing dispatch path, validates the reply and transfers
the returned dictionary with the observed ownership rules. It preserves real
receiver errors. The new export is in `IOKit.exports` so RELEASE/LTO can retain
it. The complete 71-patch application and CCIDX tests pass; 11 transport cases
pass with ASan and UBSan. Apple arm64e compilation and PAC machine-code review now pass in run 9,
as recorded below. Hardware dispatch remains unverified.

The reviewed fixture now includes its exact donor identity. Consequently the
new fixture intentionally rejects the old native kernel that lacks this symbol.
The historical five-reference replay belongs to the preceding 112-function
fixture and the unchanged run-8 native binary; it is not evidence that the new
source has already reduced the binary's missing-reference count.

Image4 caller analysis corrects the historical selector 54/55 names: 54 loads
Diavlo Root CA using two pointer/length pairs; 55 loads local policy using one.
The nonce callers ignore or discard errors, so an unsupported-return placeholder
would not provide a valid implementation. See `image4-v2-backend-notes.md` and
the pinned donor audit for the remaining state/evaluation requirements. No
Image4 placeholder or prelink bypass has been introduced.

The authorized source was published as commit
`84f7a0a6cef89f07c7af5f5a7647e74d53b22d76` on `codex/myron-iphone27`.
Phone packaging remains disabled.


## Run 9: DriverKit verified, four Image4 backend imports remain (2026-11-03)

[Run 41584153786](https://github.com/yuwenhua653/UniXNU/actions/runs/41584153786)
passed native arm64e compilation, UFS compilation, RELEASE LTO generation,
iPhone input hashes, Image4 caller audit and all 113 reviewed function identities.
The final strict prelink failed with exactly four unresolved references, all in
`com.apple.security.Image4`: nonce digest registration, nonce invalidation,
Diavlo root-CA loading and local-policy loading. No candidate was written.
The downloaded artifact SHA256 is
`58823f97d55522b5086fa862dbf72981262c3f33343bf675b7d63836e7b0afde`.

The native DriverKit method is present and mapped from its audited donor entry.
Native and LTO machine code both retain the OOL data-key discriminator `0x5d4f`,
the callback instruction-key discriminator `0xed39`, real dispatch, reply checks,
and dictionary ownership. `records/driverkit-native-codegen-41584153786.json`
records actual code hashes and addresses. This is static binary evidence, not
proof of PAC operation on myron hardware.

The desktop and replay scripts now report the exact unresolved references and
candidate-file state directly, retaining the failing status and full logs.
Contract names are used only for the hash-matched donor, zero slide and Image4
component; unknown inputs retain raw addresses. Six focused regression tests
exercise the actual report and reject mismatched name attribution.

Do not rerun the unchanged full macOS build to address these four imports:
the required change is the Image4 V2 state and authentication backend described
in `image4-v2-backend-notes.md`. Existing native and LTO artifacts are preserved
for offline analysis and replay. No successful placeholder, missing-reference
allowance, monitor bypass or phone image is introduced.


## Native monitor-NONE integration (source ready, build pending)

The four imports are now implemented for this pinned target's actual monitor-NONE
architecture. The existing normal AppleImage4 provider remains authoritative:
its real nonce roll sets the same state flag that its real digest reader checks
before returning ESTALE. The V2 calls follow those completed local operations;
there is no PPL/TXM replica in this profile. The native nonce boundary therefore
checks monitor type, prior provider registration, the verified domain range and
digest span, and acknowledges the absent mirror. It does not replace nonce
validation, return successful parser results or create a disconnected cache.

The original root/local-policy path already authenticates and publishes locally,
then skips monitor mirroring for NONE. The two native mirror exports preserve
invalid-input status 3 and panic if a valid monitor-only request reaches them.
The real parsers and evaluator remain intact. Builds with an enabled or undefined
monitor configuration are rejected; runtime nonce checks also reject a monitor.

`image4-monitor-none.patch` is the 72nd selected patch. Its installed source passes
59 ASan/UBSan host cases and four negative compiler-configuration checks. Fourteen
actual-donor instruction tests cover caller flow and the real AppleImage4 local
nonce invalidation/read path. PAC is intercepted in these host tests; metadata,
locking and some external services are modeled, so this does not qualify PAC,
concurrency, cryptography, hardware nonce storage or phone boot.

The prelink gate now pins the caller inventory, both providers, actual normal
nonce state functions and all four imported pointers. It must pass before the
117-function reviewed fixture can be used. No missing-reference allowance or
successful replacement parser is enabled. The new Apple arm64e build and strict
prelink are still pending; the last real result remains run 9's four unresolved
references using its older native binary.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Probe the compiler ABI features required by XNU 12377 arm64e before a long build."""
import argparse,json,subprocess,struct
from pathlib import Path
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True);a=p.parse_args();a.out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
s='''#if !__has_builtin(__builtin_xnu_type_summary)
#error XNU type summary builtin is required
#endif
struct slot { void * __ptrauth(2, 1, 0, "authenticates-null-values") value; };
void *load(struct slot *p) { return p->value; }
void store(struct slot *p, void *q) { p->value = q; }
'''
obj=a.out/'compiler-probe.o';args=['xcrun','--sdk','iphoneos','clang','-target','arm64e-apple-ios27.0','-mkernel','-Werror','-c','-x','c','-','-o',str(obj)]
r=subprocess.run(args,input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);(a.out/'compiler-probe.log').write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr)
version=subprocess.run(['xcrun','clang','--version'],capture_output=True,text=True)
report={'command':args,'compiler':version.stdout,'compile_passed':r.returncode==0,'phone_tested':False}
if r.returncode==0:
 header=struct.unpack_from('<8I',obj.read_bytes());report['arm64e_object']=header[0]==0xfeedfacf and header[1]==0x100000c and header[2]&0xffffff==2 and header[3]==1
else:report['error']=r.stderr
(a.out/'compiler-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if report.get('arm64e_object') else 1)

device/myron27/build_native.py.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host-only XNU build from pinned local references; never creates a phone boot image."""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
p.add_argument('--upstream',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--references',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--xnu',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('--out',type=Path,required=True)
p.add_argument('-j',type=int,default=4)
a=p.parse_args();sys.path.insert(0,str(a.upstream.resolve()/'scripts'))
from unixnu.cli import parser,cmd_defconfig
from unixnu.config import Context
from unixnu import feeds,tree,kernel
from unixnu.util import Error
base=['-D',str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent),'--out',str(a.out.resolve()),'-j',str(a.j)]
c=Context(parser().parse_args(['defconfig','myron27_defconfig',*base]));cmd_defconfig(c)
c=Context(parser().parse_args(['kernel','--skip-prelink',*base]));modules=feeds.resolve(c)
if c.need_config().get('XNU_CRYPTO_BOOTSTRAP') != 'source':
 raise Error('myron27 requires source crypto bootstrap: prelinked mode removes helpers still used by XNU 12377 OSKext')
if c.need_config().get('XNU_KERNEL_CHAINED_FIXUPS') is not True:
 raise Error('myron27 desktop integration requires XNU_KERNEL_CHAINED_FIXUPS=y')
for (kind,name),m in modules.items():
 if kind!='refer' or name=='edk2':continue
 m.path=a.xnu.resolve() if name=='xnu' else a.references.resolve()/name
 expected=m.source['commit'];actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(m.path),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
 if actual!=expected:raise Error(f'{name}: expected {expected}, got {actual}')
 m.commit=actual
for m in modules.values():
 if m.path and m.kind in ('driver','kit') and m.origin=='base':
  expected=next(s['revision'] for s in c.component_specs if s['id']==m.name)
  actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(m.path),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
  if actual!=expected:raise Error(f'{m.name}: wrong pinned component')
tree.assemble(c,modules)
kernel.build(c,modules)
kernel.prelink(c)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Apply the complete pinned patch series and test its CCIDX decoder."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tempfile

UPSTREAM = "04573c510c5fd4892ca6948739389141cc9e05f5"
XNU = "ac9718fb1af618d5ce8678d0dc6e8a58f252216f"
FILES = (
    "osfmk/arm/cpuid.c", "osfmk/arm/machine_cpuid.c",
    "osfmk/arm/cpuid_internal.h", "osfmk/arm64/start.s",
    "osfmk/arm64/machine_routines.c",
)


def run(args, cwd=None):
    return subprocess.check_output([str(x) for x in args], cwd=cwd)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--upstream", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--xnu", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    device = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    upstream, xnu = args.upstream.resolve(), args.xnu.resolve()
    for path, expected in ((upstream, UPSTREAM), (xnu, XNU)):
        if run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], path).decode().strip() != expected:
            raise SystemExit(f"Wrong source revision: {path}")
    status = json.loads(run([upstream / "unixnu", "status", "--json", "-D", device]))
    assert status["board"]["os"]["arch"] == "arm64e"
    assert status["board"]["os"]["xnu_revision"] == XNU
    assert status["board"]["board"]["example"] is True
    assert not any("10063" in p for p in status["patch_order"])
    applied = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="myron27-audit-") as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        run(["git", "clone", "--quiet", "--shared", xnu, root])
        for name in status["patch_order"]:
            patch = Path(name)
            run(["git", "apply", patch], root)
            applied.append(patch.name)
        assert "native-smp-wide-affinity.patch" in applied
        assert "arm64-ccidx-cache-geometry.patch" in applied
        run(["python3", device.parent / "test_ccidx.py", "--source",
             root / "osfmk/arm/cpuid.c", "--out", root / "decoder-test"])
    print(json.dumps({"upstream": UPSTREAM, "xnu": XNU,
                      "full_patch_application": "passed",
                      "actual_cache_decoder_host_tests": "passed",
                      "applied_patches": applied,
                      "full_kernel_built": False, "device_tested": False}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile the existing myron transport for arm64e; never bind legacy ABI offsets."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import tomllib


def module(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    result = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(result)
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--tree', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--upstream', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    tree, upstream, out = args.tree.resolve(), args.upstream.resolve(), args.out.resolve()
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    profile = tomllib.loads((here/'upstream-overlay/profiles/os/ios-27.0.1-24A446-iphone12-1/profile.toml').read_text())
    os.environ.update(UNIXNU_XNU_ARCH='arm64e', UNIXNU_IOS_VERSION='27.0')
    builder = module('driver_builder', upstream/'scripts/build-sheng-source-drivers.py')
    target = module('myron_target', upstream/'scripts/kernel_target.py')
    headers = module('storage_headers', upstream/'scripts/prepare-storage-headers.py')
    storage_pin = next(s['commit'] for s in profile['source'] if s['name']=='IOStorageFamily')
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    header_report = headers.prepare(tree/'refer/IOStorageFamily', storage_pin, out/'headers')
    recipe = tree/'build/xnu/ios-obj/DEVELOPMENT_ARM64_BCM2837/iokit/DEVELOPMENT/IOPlatformExpert.cpo.json'
    record = json.loads(recipe.read_text().strip().rstrip(','))
    target.check_object((Path(record['directory'])/'IOPlatformExpert.cpo').read_bytes(), 'kernel recipe')
    source = here.parent/'sm8850/drivers/NativeUfs/MyronUfsProbe.cpp'
    pins = json.loads((source.parent/'UPSTREAM.json').read_text())
    for entry in pins['files']:
        path = source.parent/'upstream'/entry['path']
        if path.is_file():
            data = path.read_bytes()
            if hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(data)).encode()+b'\0'+data).hexdigest()!=entry['sha']:
                raise ValueError(f'Vendored UFS source changed: {path}')
    output = out/'MyronUfsProbe.o'
    command = builder.compile_command(record, source, output,
        ['-I', str(out/'headers/include')],
        ['-DMYRON_ROOT_POLICY=0', '-Wno-missing-designated-field-initializers', '-Wno-error'])
    (out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(command, indent=2)+'\n')
    with (out/'compile.log').open('w') as log:
        subprocess.run(command, cwd=record['directory'], stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
    target.check_object(output.read_bytes(), 'myron UFS source')
    dependencies = {}
    deptext = output.with_suffix('.d').read_text().replace('\\\n', '')
    for name in shlex.split(deptext.split(':', 1)[1]):
        path = Path(name)
        if not path.is_absolute(): path = Path(record['directory'])/path
        dependencies[str(path.resolve())] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    imports = sorted(builder.nm(output, '-u'))
    report = dict(target=target.TRIPLE, compile_pass=True, source_pin=pins['commit'],
        storage_headers=header_report, object_sha256=hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        undefined_symbols=imports, dependencies=dependencies,
        legacy_absolute_bindings_added=False, kernel_linked=False, root_published=False,
        runtime_qualified=False)
    (out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
    print('PASS myron UFS arm64e source compilation; family binding remains pending', flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__': main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Replay strict prelink from an extracted CI artifact without recompiling XNU.

Requires the artifact's original prelink report, native kernel, LTO reference,
and a separately obtained, pinned iPhone kernelcache. Does not access a device.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tomllib
from verify_native_artifact import verify
from verify_reviewed_fixture import verify as verify_identities
from prelink_diagnostics import describe_failure
from audit_image4_nomonitor import audit as audit_nomonitor


def only(paths, description):
    paths = list(paths)
    if len(paths) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f'expected exactly one {description}, found {len(paths)}')
    return paths[0]


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--artifact-root', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--kernelcache', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--xnuprelink', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--out', required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root, cache, tool, out = (p.resolve() for p in (args.artifact_root, args.kernelcache, args.xnuprelink, args.out))
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    fixture = here/'fixtures/fileset-24A446-iphone12-1-symbols.json'
    installed_fixture = tool/'fixtures'/fixture.name
    if not installed_fixture.is_file() or digest(installed_fixture) != digest(fixture):
        raise ValueError('XnuPrelink has stale reviewed identities; run install_upstream.py '
                         'and use that upstream/kits/XnuPrelink checkout')
    native = only(root.glob('out/**/kernel/kernel.macho'), 'native kernel')
    reference = only(root.glob('out/**/fileset-reference/*.noctf'), 'RELEASE LTO reference')
    prior = json.loads((root/'desktop/prelinked/kernel.json').read_text())
    for path, expected in ((native, prior['inputs']['native_sha256']),
                           (cache, prior['inputs']['kernelcache_sha256']),
                           (reference, prior['reference_sha256'])):
        if digest(path) != expected:
            raise ValueError(f'replay input differs from CI prelink record: {path.name}')
    native_result = verify(native.parent, require_prelink=True)
    boundary = audit_nomonitor(cache, tool)
    identities = verify_identities(fixture, cache, native, tool)
    profile = tomllib.loads((here/'upstream-overlay/profiles/os/ios-27.0.1-24A446-iphone12-1/profile.toml').read_text())
    # Prevent a failed replay from appearing to publish a stale successful image.
    if out.exists() and any(out.iterdir()):
        raise ValueError('replay output directory must be empty')
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    command = [sys.executable, '-u', str(tool/'emit_prelink.py'), '--kernel', str(native),
               '--prelinked', str(cache), '--fileset-reference', str(reference),
               '--slide=0', '--output', str(out/'kernel.macho')]
    for name in profile['kernel']['prelink']['roots']:
        command += ['--root', name]
    (out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(command, indent=2)+'\n')
    with (out/'prelink.log').open('w') as log:
        result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    report_path = out/'kernel.json'
    report = json.loads(report_path.read_text()) if report_path.exists() else {}
    unresolved = sum(sum(v.values()) for v in report.get('missing', {}).values())
    summary = dict(native=native_result, reviewed=identities, image4_monitor_none=boundary,
                   installed_fixture_sha256=digest(installed_fixture),
                   reference_sha256=digest(reference),
                   exit_code=result.returncode, report_written=bool(report),
                   unresolved_references=unresolved if report else None,
                   candidate_written=(out/'kernel.macho').exists(),
                   runtime_qualified=False)
    if result.returncode:
        message, evidence = describe_failure(result.returncode, report_path,
                                             root/'desktop/image4-v2-contract.json')
        summary['failure_diagnostics'] = evidence
        print('FAIL strict-prelink', message, file=sys.stderr)
    (out/'replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
    if result.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Audit the selected iPhone Image4 V2 caller contracts without modifying code.

This is a static evidence check, not an implementation of the missing APIs.
No output from this tool can qualify a prelinked or phone image.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import sys

DONOR_SHA256 = '813be26ab6bd1d8de211904eca413a1a2ebf79989f90c33a48ff0f2fcff99036'
BODIES = {
    0xfffffff00a6f9fa0: (120, 'ca76636479584f32cd86f666a91c7094f45c883b66513ba2b65724645d2dd94c'),
    0xfffffff00a6fa018: (108, '6f9eb4c437ed6813792cba6185fce066eef6147200e9efcb1851dd57bb829405'),
    0xfffffff00a6fa084: (28, 'c7ade9a12cae1570a6c914af011d2d07a4ba808332b8db1a8787ffa76149da6f'),
    0xfffffff00a6fa0a0: (20, '507048440cb8ea813b3b08b0114d90ec1174a95c35f3055bfa6a9e69715c29f6'),
    0xfffffff009ea980c: (488, '0702fbbd99d8b4f602646c5a6bac7cd4b7039348e40164cc215095a2e4f3a09a'),
    0xfffffff009ea9dec: (108, '340d612a4f0c3936c101ca159329057053cb279d90bd283e125fe1835c68a04a'),
    0xfffffff009ea9e58: (712, '3204e015647972f08d6d2e7d0a27fb4d2ec9848b6e8346264e4d36fa17e64e37'),
    0xfffffff009eb86d0: (56, '058087f5b9e8b5ac88718825265a7ba973d383557b06fc4727ff86e3fdb99d1f'),
    0xfffffff009eb8708: (56, '5caeebe27129ab049ddc5e206456bef5abc274c2b2581a406a4da06dd422f1f0'),
}


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def audit(kernelcache, xnuprelink, identity=None):
    raw = kernelcache.read_bytes()
    require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == DONOR_SHA256, 'wrong iPhone donor')
    sys.path.insert(0, str(xnuprelink.resolve()))
    from kc_image import Image, scan
    image = Image(raw)
    module = Image(raw, image.entries['com.apple.security.Image4'][1])
    starts = set(module.function_starts())
    fixups = image.fixups()
    checks = 1
    for address, (size, expected) in BODIES.items():
        require(hashlib.sha256(image.read(address, size)).hexdigest() == expected,
                f'changed function body at {address:#x}')
        if address < 0xfffffff009ec0000:
            require(address in starts, f'not an Image4 function boundary: {address:#x}')
        checks += 1

    def word(address, expected):
        nonlocal checks
        require(struct.unpack('<I', image.read(address, 4))[0] == expected,
                f'changed instruction at {address:#x}')
        checks += 1

    def branch(site, target, link=True):
        nonlocal checks
        calls, _, _ = scan(image.read(site, 4), site)
        require(calls == [(site, target, link)], f'changed branch at {site:#x}')
        checks += 1

    contracts = [
        dict(selector=52, name='image4_v2_set_nonce_digest', address='0xfffffff00a6f9fa0',
             parameters=['32-bit domain ID', 'digest pointer', 'digest length'],
             got='0xfffffff0080c4550', stub='0xfffffff009eba8b8', caller='0xfffffff009ea9954',
             return_handling='ignored; caller advances to next nonce-domain record'),
        dict(selector=53, name='image4_v2_roll_nonce', address='0xfffffff00a6fa018',
             parameters=['32-bit domain ID'], got='0xfffffff0080c4548',
             stub='0xfffffff009eba8a8', caller='0xfffffff009ea9e2c',
             return_handling='discarded; caller writes zero to the operation result'),
        dict(selector=54, name='image4_v2_load_diavlo_root_ca', address='0xfffffff00a6fa084',
             parameters=['first buffer pointer', 'first length', 'second buffer pointer', 'second length'],
             got='0xfffffff0080c4538', stub='0xfffffff009eba888', caller='0xfffffff009eaa090',
             monitor_guard='code_signing_configuration monitor_type_out must be nonzero',
             entitlement='com.apple.private.img4.set-supplemental-root',
             return_handling='nonzero enters fatal helper at 0xfffffff009eb8708'),
        dict(selector=55, name='image4_v2_load_local_policy', address='0xfffffff00a6fa0a0',
             parameters=['buffer pointer', 'length'], got='0xfffffff0080c4540',
             stub='0xfffffff009eba898', caller='0xfffffff009eaa0c0',
             monitor_guard='code_signing_configuration monitor_type_out must be nonzero',
             entitlement='com.apple.private.img4.set-local-policy',
             return_handling='nonzero enters fatal helper at 0xfffffff009eb86d0'),
    ]
    for contract in contracts:
        address, got, stub, caller = (int(contract[key], 16) for key in ('address', 'got', 'stub', 'caller'))
        require(fixups[got][0] == address, f'changed imported pointer {got:#x}')
        _, refs, _ = scan(image.read(stub, 16), stub)
        require(refs == [(stub + 4, got, 'add')], f'changed imported stub {stub:#x}')
        word(stub + 8, 0xf9400230)  # ldr x16, [x17]
        word(stub + 12, 0xd71f0a11)  # braa x16, x17
        branch(caller, stub)
        checks += 2

    for address, expected in (
        (0xfffffff00a6f9fc8, 0x52800689), (0xfffffff00a6fa03c, 0x528006a8),
        (0xfffffff00a6fc368, 0x528006c8), (0xfffffff00a6fc494, 0x528006e8),
        (0xfffffff009ea9958, 0x910006f7), (0xfffffff009ea9e30, 0x52800000),
        (0xfffffff009eaa07c, 0x340000e8), (0xfffffff009eaa094, 0x35000420),
        (0xfffffff009eaa0b4, 0x340000a8), (0xfffffff009eaa0c4, 0x350002c0),
    ):
        word(address, expected)
    branch(0xfffffff009eaa118, 0xfffffff009eb8708)
    branch(0xfffffff009eaa11c, 0xfffffff009eb86d0)
    branch(0xfffffff009eb8704, 0xfffffff009eba938)
    branch(0xfffffff009eb873c, 0xfffffff009eba938)
    require(fixups[0xfffffff0080c44e0][0] == 0xfffffff00a6f8a84,
            'changed code_signing_configuration binding')
    require(fixups[0xfffffff0080c4590][0] == 0xfffffff00a9e5c18,
            'changed fatal helper binding')
    strings = {
        0xfffffff007939420: 'com.apple.private.img4.set-supplemental-root',
        0xfffffff007939519: 'com.apple.private.img4.set-local-policy',
        0xfffffff007939478: '"Image4: failed to load Diavlo Root CA with code-signing-monitor: %u" @%s:%d',
        0xfffffff00793956a: '"Image4: failed to load local policy with code-signing-monitor: %u" @%s:%d',
        0xfffffff0079394df: 'Image4: successfully loaded Diavlo Root CA on the system\n',
        0xfffffff0079395b5: 'Image4: successfully loaded local policy on the system\n',
    }
    for address, text in strings.items():
        require(image.read(address, len(text.encode()) + 1) == text.encode() + b'\0',
                f'changed caller diagnostic at {address:#x}')
        checks += 1
    monitor_components = None
    if identity:
        manifest = json.loads(identity.read_text())['Manifest']
        monitor_components = {name: manifest[name]['Info']['Path'] for name in manifest
                              if any(term in name.lower() for term in
                                     ('txm', 'sptm', 'trustedexecutionmonitor', 'securepagetablemonitor'))}
    return dict(donor_sha256=DONOR_SHA256, static_checks_passed=checks,
                contracts=contracts, diagnostics={hex(k): v for k, v in strings.items()},
                full_body_hashes={hex(k): {'size': v[0], 'sha256': v[1]} for k, v in BODIES.items()},
                naming_correction='The historical selector54/55 candidate names were reversed. '
                'Entitlements, caller success diagnostics, fatal diagnostics and argument counts '
                'identify selector54 as Diavlo Root CA and selector55 as local policy.',
                selected_manifest_monitor_components=monitor_components,
                unsupported_return_is_a_complete_implementation=False,
                runtime_backend_implemented=False, prelink_qualified=False, phone_tested=False)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--kernelcache', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--xnuprelink', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--identity', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--out', required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report = audit(args.kernelcache, args.xnuprelink, args.identity)
    args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(f"PASS: {report['static_checks_passed']} static Image4 contract checks; runtime APIs remain unimplemented")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Apply the real XNU patch, verify donor bytes, and exercise RPC marshalling.

This is a host transport test, not an Apple arm64e build or runtime qualification.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--xnu', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--kernelcache', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--xnuprelink', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--out', required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    patch = here.parent/'patches/xnu/driverkit-call-platform-function.patch'
    sys.path.insert(0, str(args.xnuprelink.resolve()))
    from kc_image import Image
    data = args.kernelcache.read_bytes()
    expected = '813be26ab6bd1d8de211904eca413a1a2ebf79989f90c33a48ff0f2fcff99036'
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != expected:
        raise ValueError('CallPlatformFunction evidence requires the exact iPhone 24A446 donor')
    collection = Image(data)
    kernel = Image(data, collection.entries['com.apple.kernel'][1])
    start, end = 0xfffffff00a88bbd8, 0xfffffff00a88bdb8
    starts = kernel.function_starts()
    if start not in starts or min(x for x in starts if x > start) != end:
        raise ValueError('DriverKit function boundaries differ')
    function_digest = hashlib.sha256(kernel.read(start, end-start)).hexdigest()
    if function_digest != '131d8abd57349d5ec0fbd5db5f5a0a77805401fb14457f46218952801006e3be':
        raise ValueError('DriverKit client function changed')
    for address, fmt, expected_values in [
        (0xfffffff00700fcc0, '<QQ', (0xbf66f4287c60ef85, 0x100)),
        (0xfffffff00700e688, '<II', (0x4da2b68c, 3)),
        (0xfffffff00700e718, '<II', (0x8c, 0x98)),
    ]:
        if struct.unpack(fmt, collection.read(address, struct.calcsize(fmt))) != expected_values:
            raise ValueError('DriverKit wire constants changed')
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='myron27-driverkit-') as tmp:
        tree = Path(tmp)
        for relative in ('config/IOKit.exports', 'iokit/IOKit/IOService.h', 'iokit/Kernel/IOUserServer.cpp'):
            dest = tree/relative
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(args.xnu/relative, dest)
        subprocess.run(['git', 'apply', '--check', str(patch)], cwd=tree, check=True)
        subprocess.run(['git', 'apply', str(patch)], cwd=tree, check=True)
        binary = tree/'rpc-host-test'
        command = ['g++', '-std=c++17', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror',
                   '-fsanitize=address,undefined', '-I', str(tree/'iokit/Kernel'),
                   str(here/'driverkit_rpc_host.cpp'), '-o', str(binary)]
        subprocess.run(command, check=True)
        # The execution sandbox cannot inspect /proc for LeakSanitizer; this
        # test allocates no heap objects. Address/undefined checks remain on.
        env = dict(os.environ, ASAN_OPTIONS='detect_leaks=0')
        result = subprocess.run([str(binary)], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        symbol = '_ZN9IOService20CallPlatformFunctionEP8OSStringbP12OSDictionaryPS3_PFiP15OSMetaClassBase5IORPCE'
        symbols = subprocess.check_output(['nm', str(binary)], text=True)
        if ('_'+symbol) not in (tree/'config/IOKit.exports').read_text().splitlines():
            raise ValueError('DriverKit client missing from kernel exports')
        if not any(line.endswith(' T '+symbol) for line in symbols.splitlines()):
            raise ValueError('Generated C++ symbol does not match donor method signature')
    report = dict(donor_sha256=expected, original=hex(start), original_size=end-start,
                  original_sha256=function_digest, native_symbol='_'+symbol,
                  host_cases_passed=11, patch_application_passed=True,
                  sanitizer='ASan and UBSan; leak scanner disabled',
                  native_arm64e_compiled=False, runtime_qualified=False,
                  client_rpc_only=True, host_output=result.stdout.strip())
    args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

        (0xfffffff01703d5c0, 0xfffffff01706f544, False),
        (0xfffffff01703b268, 0xfffffff01703c8b4, True),
        (0xfffffff01703c934, 0xfffffff01703d5c4, True),
        (0xfffffff01703d64c, 0xfffffff017039aa4, True),
        (0xfffffff017039aa8, 0xfffffff01706e4ec, False),
        (0xfffffff01703b614, 0xfffffff01703c980, True),
        (0xfffffff01703c9c8, 0xfffffff01703d6b0, True),
        (0xfffffff01703d6fc, 0xfffffff017039aac, True),
        (0xfffffff017039ab0, 0xfffffff01706e6c8, False),
        (0xfffffff0170711e4, 0xfffffff0170716e4, True),
        (0xfffffff01706e62c, 0xfffffff01706e664, True),
    ):
        branch(site, target, link)
    encoded = struct.unpack('<Q', image.read(0xfffffff01702d478, 8))[0]
    require(image.base + (encoded & 0xffffffff) == FUNCTIONS['nonce_read'][0],
            'wrong expert nonce-read implementation')
    checks += 1
    return dict(
        target='iPhone12,1 / n104ap / iOS27.0.1 24A446', inputs=inputs,
        static_contract_checks_passed=checks, selector_dispatch=dispatch,
        function_bodies={name: dict(address=hex(a), size=n, sha256=h) for name, (a, n, h) in FUNCTIONS.items()},
        registry=dict(pointer='0xfffffff01702d370', domains=17, record_bytes=64,
                      rolled_offset=0, digest_offset=8, digest_capacity=48, length_offset=56,
                      duplicate_registration='fatal', invalid_domain='fatal for set/roll',
                      reader_status={'invalid_domain': 1, 'rolled': 2, 'unset': 10, 'success': 0}),
        evaluation_consumer=dict(callsite='0xfffffff0170711e4', adapter='0xfffffff0170716e4',
                                 expert_table='0xfffffff01702d378', slot_offset='0x100',
                                 reader='0xfffffff01706f75c'),
        root_policy_dependencies={
            'selector54': 'two validated page-donation descriptors -> private root/manifest parser '
                          'and evaluation chain -> expert publication slot 0x120',
            'selector55': 'one validated page-donation descriptor -> private policy parser '
                          'and evaluation chain -> stng/sphi property publication',
            'copied_blob_is_not_equivalent': True,
        },
        implementation_scope='Evidence only; no native runtime replacement, firmware changes or missing-symbol mappings',
        runtime_backend_implemented=False, phone_tested=False,
    )


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--firmware-dir', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--identity', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--xnuprelink', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--out', required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    report = audit(args.firmware_dir, args.identity, args.xnuprelink)
    args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(f"PASS: 2 manifest-bound monitor inputs, {report['static_contract_checks_passed']} TXM static checks; backend not implemented")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# iPhone 24A446 Image4 V2 backend evidence

The initial audit below predates the target-only monitor-NONE implementation
recorded at the end of this file. It corrects
their identities and records their actual callers; it does not add success or
unsupported stubs. Run `audit_image4_contract.py` against the pinned iPhone donor
to reproduce the checks in `records/image4-v2-contract-24A446.json`.

## Corrected identities

| Selector | Donor entry | Interface identified from the caller | Arguments |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 52 | `0xfffffff00a6f9fa0` | `image4_v2_set_nonce_digest` | domain ID, digest pointer, length |
| 53 | `0xfffffff00a6fa018` | `image4_v2_roll_nonce` | domain ID |
| 54 | `0xfffffff00a6fa084` | `image4_v2_load_diavlo_root_ca` | two pointer/length pairs |
| 55 | `0xfffffff00a6fa0a0` | `image4_v2_load_local_policy` | one pointer/length pair |

The historical repair record reversed the candidate names for selectors 54 and
55. The selected donor's object-load path requires the supplemental-root
entitlement for selector 54 and the local-policy entitlement for selector 55.
Its success and fatal diagnostics independently identify the same objects.
The exact C typedefs remain private; the argument shapes above describe the
observed AArch64 ABI and do not assign unverified public types.

## Why unsupported-return placeholders are not sufficient

- The nonce-digest initialization caller advances to the next domain immediately
  after selector 52; it does not inspect the return value.
- The nonce-roll caller first updates the Image4 kext's domain state, invokes
  selector 53, and then sets the reported operation result to zero. An
  unsupported-return implementation would therefore report success while leaving
  the mirror state stale.
- Both object-load paths validate and load the object in the Image4 kext first.
  They mirror it into the code-signing monitor only when
  `code_signing_configuration(&monitor_type, NULL)` returns a nonzero monitor
  type. A nonzero mirror result invokes a fatal diagnostic. The current native
  source reports `CS_MONITOR_TYPE_NONE` when built without a monitor, but that
  does not implement these exported interfaces or establish future call safety.
- The original wrappers decode transport error domain `0x2b` and a 16-bit
  service status, returning `0xffff` for a foreign domain. POSIX `ENOTSUP` is
  not an established replacement for this private result contract.

The selected N104 `BuildIdentity.json` lists `Ap,TrustedExecutionMonitor` and
`Ap,SecurePageTableMonitor`, plus restore variants. Searching only for the
abbreviations TXM/SPTM misses these entries. Both exact components were fetched
using range extraction from the pinned IPSW. Each IM4P's SHA384 matches its
selected BuildIdentity Digest. `audit_txm_image4.py` verifies those inputs and
53 static contract checks; the result is `records/txm-image4-contract-24A446.json`.
The binaries are research inputs and are not part of the public source bundle.

## Actual N104 monitor results

The TXM payload SHA256 is
`e058931840ac000f6d050578fd7fc4ddb8c640125d92a713f61433be793fbf04`.
The monitor dispatch uses a selector-minus-one index into the table at
`0xfffffff01703b684`, with offsets relative to `0xfffffff01703b208`.

| Selector | Actual TXM path after dispatch | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 52 | `0x1703c848` bounds wrapper, `0x1703d5b4` trampoline, `0x1706f4a0` setter | Registers one bounded digest; invalid IDs/lengths or repeat registration are fatal |
| 53 | `0x1703d5bc` trampoline, `0x1706f544` invalidator | Sets the selected record's rolled flag |
| 54 | `0x1703c8b4` page bounds, `0x1703d5c4` ownership handling, `0x1706e4ec` root load | Parses two inputs, runs the private evaluation chain, publishes through expert slot `0x120` |
| 55 | `0x1703c980` page bounds, `0x1703d6b0` ownership handling, `0x1706e6c8` policy load | Parses one input, runs the private evaluation chain, publishes the `stng` and `sphi` properties |

Addresses in this table omit the common `0xfffffff000000000` prefix for
readability; the JSON report retains complete addresses.

The digest registry has 17 records of 64 bytes: rolled flag at `+0`, 48-byte
digest at `+8`, committed length at `+0x38`. The setter commits the length after
copying; the wrapper rejects null, zero-length and overflowing input spans.
The reader at `0xfffffff01706f75c` returns 1 for invalid domain, 10 for an unset
digest, 2 for a rolled digest and 0 only after copying the digest and length.
The evaluation caller `0xfffffff0170711e4` reaches that reader through expert
table `0xfffffff01702d378`, slot `0x100`. This directly proves that a nonce
registry whose state is not used by the evaluator is an incomplete port.

Merely possessing the Apple monitor does not establish that it can execute on
SM8850. The transport and page ownership code depends on its SPTM environment;
the two object loaders additionally depend on the private parser/evaluator and
the expert's publication callbacks.

To reproduce from these separately extracted private inputs:

```sh
python3 kernel/myron27/audit_txm_image4.py \
  --firmware-dir /path/to/ipsw/24A446 \
  --identity /path/to/ipsw/24A446/BuildIdentity.json \
  --xnuprelink /path/to/XnuPrelink \
  --out /path/to/txm-image4-contract-24A446.json
```

The firmware directory must contain `txm.iphoneos.release.im4p`,
`txm.iphoneos.release.macho`, `sptm.t8030.release.im4p` and
`sptm.t8030.release.macho`. The `.macho` files are decompressed IM4P payloads;
all four hashes and both manifest digests are checked before code inspection.

## Smallest complete backend work

1. Bind the now-verified 17-domain, 48-byte-digest registry to the selected
   donor's actual initialization source. The start path reads each numeric
   domain ID from offset `0x14` of a `0x78`-byte record and passes a digest with
   an explicit length. Do not substitute the older img4 nonce-domain IDs.
2. Implement one synchronized digest registry with a defined initialization,
   duplicate-set and destruction policy. A digest is not the cleartext nonce
   accepted by the older `kernel_image4_set_nonce` API. Do not cast one form
   into the other.
3. Make nonce invalidation update that same registry and make every V2 trust
   evaluation consult its rolled state. A disconnected cache plus a successful
   roll result does not provide anti-replay behavior. The public
   `image4_environment_roll_nonce` API accepts an opaque environment pointer;
   it cannot be called with the V2 numeric domain ID without a verified mapping.
4. For root-CA and local-policy loading, bind to the actual authenticated
   parser/provider, preserve object ownership and duplicate/replacement rules,
   and make future evaluations use the published state. The kext's initial
   local parse followed by monitor publication is visible in the donor; the
   private monitor's mirror/evaluation contract is still needed.
5. Preserve errors in the private result domain and review the callers that
   ignore them before enabling a native replacement. Compile/link success alone
   cannot qualify this backend.

## New reference, with explicit limits

Snapintosh has a directly inspectable selector-52 registry implementation and
a binary-contract test at commit
[`940eeb95ba637528dc45ba098e6b8091163dd489`](https://github.com/Snapintosh/Snapintosh/tree/940eeb95ba637528dc45ba098e6b8091163dd489):

- [`compat/txm/image4_aspace.c`](https://github.com/Snapintosh/Snapintosh/blob/940eeb95ba637528dc45ba098e6b8091163dd489/compat/txm/image4_aspace.c)
- [`tools/test-txm-nonce-digest-contract.py`](https://github.com/Snapintosh/Snapintosh/blob/940eeb95ba637528dc45ba098e6b8091163dd489/tools/test-txm-nonce-digest-contract.py)

Its inspected implementation copies at most 48 bytes into one of 17 records,
rejects duplicate registration, and erases the temporary copy. Its published
tests are pinned to mac17p/j700; our new N104 audit independently confirms the
same size bounds, record layout and duplicate rule in the selected donor. Its
`image4_aspace.c` does not implement selectors 53, 54 or 55. Its older
selector-45 nonce path stores a different 44-byte raw/encrypted nonce payload.
Consequently, copying that file would still not supply the missing N104
V2 invalidation/root-policy/evaluation lifecycle.

No vendor binary, borrowed absolute address, successful placeholder or modified
security result is introduced by this audit. Positive checks and two negative
checks (wrong donor, changed function-body expectation) passed locally.

## Provider recovered after build 41584153786

That build compiled the DriverKit replacement and reached strict prelink with
exactly the four Image4 imports above unresolved. A further donor inspection
found a narrower implementation route than rebuilding the TXM parser: the
Image4 kext already registers a six-entry provider table through
`image4_v2_interface_register`. The table at `0xfffffff0080c2480` contains:

| Offset | Provider entry | Observed operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `0x00` | `0xfffffff009eacd00` | Initialize PPL storage and expert |
| `0x08` | `0xfffffff009eace64` | Set one nonce digest |
| `0x10` | `0xfffffff009eacf6c` | Invalidate one nonce |
| `0x18` | `0xfffffff009eb25b4` | Actual local Diavlo root loader |
| `0x20` | `0xfffffff009eb2790` | Actual local policy loader |
| `0x28` | `0xfffffff009eacff8` | Unidentified operation returning 8 |

The root and policy slots are the same functions invoked by the kext's local
object-load path before monitor mirroring. Their presence is evidence of a real
available parser/provider, not evidence that calling them a second time is
valid. Duplicate/replacement handling and ownership still require qualification.

The nonce implementation is a **PPL provider**, not a generic no-monitor API.
Its initializer requires exactly `0x490` bytes and monitor type 1 (PPL), and
panics with `attempted to initialize PPL expert without a PPL` otherwise. Both
nonce mutations require PPL execution context or the transient initialization
flag. The storage contains the same 17 records of 64 bytes seen in TXM. Its
expert table at `0xfffffff0080c26b0`, slot `0x100`, calls reader
`0xfffffff009ead05c`, which observes the setter's digest and the roll flag.

Two actual evaluation callsites (`0xfffffff009eaf520` and
`0xfffffff009eaf704`) reach adapter `0xfffffff009eafb54`; that adapter reads the
selected expert's `0x100` slot. Expert selector `0xfffffff009eac4f0` selects the
PPL table only in PPL/initialization context. Otherwise it returns the normal
table at `0xfffffff0080c2348`, whose nonce reader `0xfffffff009eac640` uses the
existing kext domain lookup and `0xfffffff009eb6c94`. Thus local evaluation and
monitor evaluation are distinct real paths. This supports investigating an
explicit no-monitor integration, but does **not** yet prove that dropping the
four mirror calls is a complete interface implementation.

The current source's registration patch
`upstream/patches/xnu-12377/darwin26-kpi.patch` only retains the opaque provider
pointer. Pinned public XNU's `bsd/kern/code_signing/xnu.c` delegates legacy nonce
operations through `IMG4_RUNTIME_PMAP_CS`; its new monitor trap panics without a
monitor. The public `libkern/libkern/image4/interface.h` table exposes environment
and trust APIs, but does not describe this separate V2 table. Neither interface
is an ABI-safe substitute for the discovered six-slot provider.

The next implementation gate is now specific: define and validate a native
provider lifecycle and context that the selected kext supports, or prove a
complete no-monitor lifecycle using the normal provider. Preserve its existing
parser, evaluation, nonce invalidation, and ownership behavior. Do not claim a
PPL exists by changing `code_signing_configuration`, relax the context assertions,
or add unconditional successful return functions to satisfy the four imports.

Reproduce the 54 provider checks (plus wrong-donor and changed-body rejection)
with `audit_image4_provider.py`; the current result is
`records/image4-provider-contract-24A446.json`. All addresses are analysis
identities only, never native runtime pointers. No new runtime replacement or
prelink mapping has been added.


## Qualified source route: preserve the native no-monitor provider

Further independent tracing resolves the earlier concern about a stale replica
for this particular profile: the normal AppleImage4 expert owns its own domain
collection and initialization. Its real `environment_roll_nonce` reaches the
same object, lock and state that `environment_copy_nonce_digest` reads; the
mutation sets state bit 1 and the reader returns ESTALE (70). It does not consult
the new PPL table or call back into selectors 52/53. See
`records/image4-monitor-none-independent-review.json` and the real-state cases in
`tests/test_image4_donor_lifecycle.py`.

The resulting `patches/xnu/image4-monitor-none.patch` deliberately implements
only the absent-mirror boundary for monitor NONE. It retains the original local
provider and all actual authentication/parser work. It never initializes the
PPL provider, reports PPL/TXM, copies digest bytes into an unused registry or
claims a valid monitor policy request succeeded. The setter/roll acknowledgments
are justified by the pinned exclusive callers having already completed their
real local operation. Registration alone is not proof of that operation; the
prelink audit enforces the complete donor and call-site inventory.

The policy mirror exports reject invalid input with the observed status 3 and
panic if an unexpected valid call arrives. This follows the public XNU
no-monitor trap policy while preserving the original local parsing path. It is
not a monitor backend and must not be extended to another donor or enabled-monitor
target without new interface and lifecycle work. Native compile/prelink and
hardware qualification remain separate gates.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify pinned DriverKit RPC code generation in an extracted CI artifact.

Resolve native/LTO symbols, function extents, Invoke and constant-pool addresses
from each image. Donor identity comes from the reviewed contract. The recorded
prelink status may be either complete or incomplete; it is never substituted
with a fixed expectation. Static code inspection is not PAC/hardware execution.
"""
import argparse
import bisect
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import sys


def require(value, message):
    if not value:
        raise ValueError(message)


def unique_file(root, pattern):
    matches = sorted(root.glob(pattern))
    require(len(matches) == 1, f'Expected one {pattern} under {root}, found {len(matches)}')
    return matches[0]


def audit_image(label, path, contract, Image, scan):
    import capstone
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    image = Image(raw)
    symbols = image.symbols()
    names = {n: a for a, entries in symbols.items() for n in entries}
    if label == 'donor':
        require(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == contract['donor_sha256'], 'Changed donor image')
        address, size = int(contract['original'], 16), contract['original_size']
    else:
        require(contract['native_symbol'] in names, f'{label}: missing RPC export')
        address = names[contract['native_symbol']]
        starts = sorted(set(image.function_starts()))
        require(address in starts, f'{label}: missing RPC function start')
        index = bisect.bisect_right(starts, address)
        require(index < len(starts), f'{label}: no next function start')
        size = starts[index] - address
    body = image.read(address, size)
    if label == 'donor':
        require(hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() == contract['original_sha256'], 'Changed donor RPC body')
    md = capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_ARM64, capstone.CS_MODE_ARM)
    decoded = list(md.disasm(body, address))
    require(len(decoded) * 4 == size, f'{label}: incomplete RPC instruction decode')
    text = [(i.mnemonic, i.op_str) for i in decoded]
    checks = 0

    def has(mnemonic, operands):
        nonlocal checks
        require((mnemonic, operands) in text, f'{label}: missing {mnemonic} {operands}')
        checks += 1

    def count(mnemonic, operands, expected):
        nonlocal checks
        require(text.count((mnemonic, operands)) == expected,
                f'{label}: expected {expected} instances of {mnemonic} {operands}')
        checks += 1

    has('pacibsp', '')
    has('retab', '')
    count('movk', 'x16, #0x5d4f, lsl #48', 2)
    count('pacda', 'x17, x16', 2)
    has('add', 'x16, x8, #0x34')
    has('add', 'x16, x8, #0x44')
    has('mov', 'w17, #0x20')
    has('mov', 'w17, #0x28')
    has('stur', 'x17, [sp, #0x54]')
    has('stur', 'x17, [sp, #0x64]')
    has('mov', 'x17, #0xed39')
    has('blraa', 'x5, x17')
    calls, refs, _ = scan(body, address)
    if label == 'donor':
        # The pinned reviewed donor body has one direct call. Its remaining
        # dispatch/type/release calls are authenticated indirect calls.
        direct = [target for _, target, link in calls if link]
        require(len(direct) == 1, 'Donor Invoke direct-call identity changed')
        invoke = direct[0]
    else:
        invoke_name = '__ZN15OSMetaClassBase6InvokeE5IORPC'
        require(invoke_name in names, f'{label}: missing Invoke symbol')
        invoke = names[invoke_name]
    has('bl', f'#{invoke:#x}')
    invoke_index = text.index(('bl', f'#{invoke:#x}'))
    require(text[invoke_index - 1] == ('mov', 'x1, sp') and
            text[invoke_index + 1][0] == 'cbnz' and
            text[invoke_index + 1][1].startswith('w0, '),
            f'{label}: Invoke argument/error propagation changed')
    has('mov', 'w9, #0x8c')
    has('cmp', 'w8, #0x54')
    has('cmp', 'w8, #1')
    has('cmp', 'x8, #1')
    has('mov', 'x9, #0xef85')
    for operands in ('x9, #0x7c60, lsl #16', 'x9, #0xf428, lsl #32', 'x9, #0xbf66, lsl #48'):
        has('movk', operands)
    has('strb', 'w2, [sp, #0xa4]')
    for operands in ('x0, [x8, #0x6c]', 'x1, [x8, #0x74]', 'x3, [x8, #0x7c]'):
        has('stur', operands)
    has('movk', 'x16, #0x3a87, lsl #48')
    has('ldr', 'x8, [x16, #0x28]!')
    has('blraa', 'x8, x16')

    # A matching byte sequence elsewhere in the image is insufficient: require
    # a unique constant address reached by an actual PC-relative load in this
    # exact method. This keeps relocation independent without guessing offsets.
    constants = {}
    expected_constants = dict(
        header=struct.pack('<II', 0x4da2b68c, 3),
        method_flags=struct.pack('<QQ', int(contract['method_id'], 16), 0x100),
        buffer_sizes=struct.pack('<II', 0x8c, 0x98))
    for name, expected in expected_constants.items():
        found = set()
        for _, target, kind in refs:
            if kind != 'ldst':
                continue
            try:
                actual = image.read(target, len(expected))
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if actual == expected:
                found.add(target)
        require(len(found) == 1, f'{label}: absent/ambiguous referenced {name} constant: {found}')
        constants[name] = hex(found.pop())
        checks += 1
    return dict(image_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        symbol=contract['native_symbol'] if label != 'donor' else 'pinned stripped donor identity',
        address=hex(address), body_bytes=size, body_sha256=hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(),
        direct_invoke=hex(invoke), constant_pool_addresses=constants,
        ool_data_key_pac_discriminator='0x5d4f', ool_address_diversity=True,
        ool_signed_values=['0x20', '0x28'], ool_descriptor_offsets=['0x34', '0x44'],
        supermethod_instruction_key_pac_discriminator='0xed39',
        method_id=contract['method_id'], request_flags='0x100', request_bytes=140,
        reply_bytes=84, buffer_bytes=152, checks_passed=checks,
        disassembly=[dict(address=hex(i.address), mnemonic=i.mnemonic, operands=i.op_str)
                     for i in decoded])


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--artifact-root', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--donor', '--kernelcache', dest='donor', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--xnuprelink', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--contract', type=Path,
                        default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'records/driverkit-rpc-contract.json')
    parser.add_argument('--out', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--candidate', type=Path,
                        help='Optional locally reproduced candidate; CI archives may omit donor-derived images')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    sys.path.insert(0, str(args.xnuprelink.resolve()))
    from kc_image import Image, scan
    root = args.artifact_root.resolve()
    native = unique_file(root, '**/myron27/kernel/kernel.macho')
    lto = unique_file(root, '**/myron27/tree/build/xnu/fileset-reference/mach.release.bcm2837.unstripped.noctf')
    report_path = unique_file(root, '**/prelinked/kernel.json')
    mapping_path = unique_file(root, '**/prelinked/kernel.map.json')
    contract = json.loads(args.contract.read_text())
    result = dict(status='failed', images={}, phone_tested=False, runtime_qualified=False,
        limitations=['Static code generation and CI prelink records; no hardware PAC or target execution.',
                     'Instruction assertions preserve the reviewed compiler pattern and fail on unreviewed changes.',
                     'A successful method audit does not imply complete prelink or a phone firmware.'])
    try:
        for label, path in (('donor', args.donor), ('native', native), ('lto', lto)):
            result['images'][label] = audit_image(label, path, contract, Image, scan)
        report = json.loads(report_path.read_text())
        mapping = json.loads(mapping_path.read_text())
        entry = mapping['functions'][contract['original']]
        require(entry['native'] == result['images']['native']['address'] and entry['how'] == 'reviewed',
                'Prelink did not use the reviewed native DriverKit identity')
        require(entry['name'] == contract['native_symbol'], 'Prelink method symbol changed')
        require(report['inputs']['native_sha256'] == result['images']['native']['image_sha256'],
                'Prelink native digest does not match audited image')
        require(report['reference_sha256'] == result['images']['lto']['image_sha256'],
                'Prelink LTO digest does not match audited image')
        require(report['inputs']['kernelcache_sha256'] == result['images']['donor']['image_sha256'],
                'Prelink donor digest does not match audited image')
        # The contract's records directory sits alongside the authoritative
        # native-artifact verifier, avoiding a workspace-specific import path.
        verifier = args.contract.resolve().parent.parent / 'verify_native_artifact.py'
        require(verifier.is_file(), f'Missing native verification module: {verifier}')
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('myron_native_verifier', verifier)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        result['native_artifact_verification'] = module.verify(native.parent, require_prelink=True)
        result['reviewed_prelink_binding'] = entry
        result['prelink'] = dict(mapping_complete=report.get('mapping_complete'),
            candidate_written=report.get('candidate_written'), missing=report.get('missing'),
            unresolved_reference_count=sum(sum(refs.values()) for refs in report.get('missing', {}).values()))
        if report.get('candidate_written'):
            archived_candidate = report_path.with_name('kernel.macho')
            result['prelink']['candidate_in_uploaded_artifact'] = archived_candidate.is_file()
            candidate = args.candidate or archived_candidate
            if args.candidate:
                require(candidate.is_file(), 'Explicitly supplied candidate does not exist')
            if candidate.is_file():
                result['prelink']['candidate_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(candidate.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                result['prelink']['candidate_bytes'] = candidate.stat().st_size
                require(result['prelink']['candidate_sha256'] == report['candidate_sha256']
                        and result['prelink']['candidate_bytes'] == report['candidate_bytes'],
                        'Candidate bytes do not match the CI prelink record')
                result['prelink']['candidate_source'] = 'explicit local replay' if args.candidate else 'CI artifact'
        result['status'] = 'apple_arm64e_native_and_lto_codegen_verified'
    except Exception as error:
        result['error'] = f'{type(error).__name__}: {error}'
    args.out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.out.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(status=result['status'], error=result.get('error'),
                         prelink=result.get('prelink'), report=str(args.out)), indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(int('error' in result))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
